description: Asked who does the washing, and said a shirt is not an oath.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Measured the loaf, asked about Tuesday night, and gave the ruling while she still had the jug.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Asked whether the ladies are punished too, and left the oath to the gentlemen.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Paid, told the plot as far as the ladies' arrival, and wrote washing.
name: William Shakespeare
